purpose: Canonical staging map for normalizing every typed collectible reward from PQ 1-162 into Skills, Super Souls, Clothing, Accessories, and Artworks.

normalization_policy.skills: Resolve each named skill reward to the canonical skills database ID before marking verified.
normalization_policy.super_souls: Resolve each named Super Soul to a canonical Super Soul record before marking verified.
normalization_policy.clothing: Separate clothing from accessories and preserve exact item naming.
normalization_policy.accessories: Preserve exact accessory naming and do not infer an accessory from a costume name.
normalization_policy.artworks: Store artwork numbers as stable artwork references where the source provides them.
normalization_policy.currency: Zeni and capsule currency/items are not placed in collectible cross-domain arrays unless a dedicated item-domain record exists.

notes: This file deliberately does not fabricate reward relationships where the existing PQ batch data has not yet been normalized.
The existing PQ batch records remain the source staging layer; this file is the canonical typed-reward target for PQ 1-162.
A record may be promoted from indexed_pending_record_resolution to partially_verified or verified only after its named rewards resolve to canonical domain records and provenance is retained.
